import json,subprocess,sys,os,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);p=r/"payload"
modules="core registries endpoints timing assays overlap exposure admission prat_review matrices release reporting workflow demo".split()
command=[str(r/"venv/bin/python"),"-B","-m","mypy","--strict","--explicit-package-bases","--ignore-missing-imports","--follow-imports=silent","--no-incremental","--cache-dir",str(r/"review-mypy-cache")]+["tools/a_dav/"+m+".py" for m in modules]+["runner.py"]
x=subprocess.run(command,cwd=p,env={"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE":"1","PATH":"/usr/bin:/bin","HOME":str(r),"TZ":"UTC"},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
(r/"parent-mypy.stdout.log").write_text(x.stdout);(r/"parent-mypy.stderr.log").write_text(x.stderr)
fs={}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="parent-fs-probe-",dir=r) as d:
 q=Path(d);(q/"case").write_bytes(b"SYNTHETIC_ONLY");fs["case_sensitive"]=not(q/"CASE").exists();(q/"link").symlink_to(q/"case");fs["symlink_supported"]=(q/"link").is_symlink();fs["device"]=q.stat().st_dev;v=os.statvfs(q);fs["filesystem_block_size"]=v.f_bsize;fs["filesystem_name_max"]=v.f_namemax
y={"classification":"SYNTHETIC_ONLY","command":command,"cwd":str(p),"exit_code":x.returncode,"filesystem_probe":fs,"real_source_data_used":False,"shared_environment_modified":False}
(r/"parent-review.json").write_text(json.dumps(y,indent=2)+"\n");print(json.dumps(y))
